_comment: 无人值守内容流水线的目标关键词库。gen_article.py 每次取 keywords 里第一个未发布的词；写完一轮后在 'later' 里补充新词。angle 是给 LLM 的写作角度提示。

keywords.angle: Honest overview of what free background removal actually offers: quality limits, resolution caps, watermarks elsewhere. Explain how ClearPNG's free tier (3 images/month, no watermark, full resolution) compares and when a paid plan makes sense. Avoid naming competitors negatively.
Explain transparency in PNG files, why saving as JPG destroys transparency, step-by-step online workflow, and common mistakes (semi-transparent edges, halos around subjects).

Ecommerce product photography: consistent backgrounds, marketplace requirements, when to use white vs transparent backgrounds, and how to process product shots quickly. Interlink the product photo tool page and the Shopify best practices post.

keywords.keyword: how to remove logo background without photoshop
keywords.angle: Photoshop is overkill for simple logo cutouts. Walk through no-Photoshop workflows (online tools), edge quality considerations for logos, SVG/transparent PNG export notes. Interlink the logo use-case page and transparent-vs-white logo post.
Technical but practical: why white backgrounds block design work, automatic white-to-transparent conversion, edge halos and how AI cutouts avoid them, file format guidance.

keywords.keyword: background remover for shopify store owners
keywords.angle: Shopify-specific workflow: product image requirements, bulk processing tips for collections, consistency across a catalog. Interlink the Shopify best practices post and product photo tool page.

keywords.keyword: remove background from picture on iphone
keywords.angle: Mobile workflow: iPhone's built-in subject lift limitations vs full online tools, saving transparent PNGs correctly on iOS, use cases (messages, docs, social).

keywords.keyword: transparent signature image for email and pdf
keywords.angle: Beyond Word: using transparent signatures in email clients, PDF signing, and forms. Interlink the signature remover page and the Word signature post.
Batch strategies for multiple images: planning file naming, credit math for batches, when batch tools vs per-image quality control matter. Practical checklist format.
Canva workflows that need transparent PNGs (logos, stickers, overlays), how to prepare cutouts for Canva import, common transparency mistakes in Canva exports.

keywords.keyword: ai background remover how it works
keywords.angle: Accessible explanation of how AI background removal works (subject segmentation models, edge refinement), why AI beats manual lasso work, limitations to know about.

keywords.keyword: remove background from headshot for linkedin
keywords.angle: Professional headshot use: LinkedIn photo guidelines, replacing backgrounds cleanly, keeping natural hair/shoulder edges, recommended export settings.

later.angle: Spanish-language article (write the article in Spanish).
German-language article (write the article in German).

later.keyword: remove background from passport photo requirements
later.angle: Passport/ID photo white background requirements by use case; careful with official rules - describe common requirements and advise checking official sources.
Comparison article. Research actual current pricing first; be fair, focus on free-tier value comparison.
